notes.title: DEMO1.05
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made to the DEMO version.

・Fixed a phenomenon in which a fairy would occasionally fall into a wall and warp to a strange place when climbing a wall.
・Fixed a phenomenon in which an enemy girl's body would twist in rare cases.

notes.title: DEMO1.04
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made to the DEMO version

・Added a way to check for carrot hints in the tutorial.
・Adjusted the hiding point of the table in the living room.

notes.title: DEMO1.03
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made to the DEMO version

・Added menu closing instructions to the menu screen.
・Some objects have been changed.
・Fixed a bug that the fairy would get off the ladder when the menu was opened and the "Get off the ladder button" was pressed while the fairy was climbing the ladder.

notes.title: DEMO1.02
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made to the DEMO version

・Some tutorial changes and operation hints have been added.
・Shortened the time it takes for the enemy alert phase to be released.
・Added ladders to some parts of the map to make it easier to ascend to the top of the room.
・Fixed some hiding spots.
・Fixed the warp function in the DEMO version.

notes.title: Gentleman's Mode
notes.notes:
Hello.
This is limited to the production version, but I am implementing a setting called "gentleman's mode," which reduces the amount of skin exposure of the fairies.
There were a few people who were concerned about the skin exposure in the video distribution and live distribution, so I am implementing this setting with that in mind.
It's okay as long as you cover your private parts properly... right?
The body paint is the developer's sense of fun.

notes.title: Video distribution guidelines are described.
notes.notes:
Hello.
I have included our video distribution guidelines on my store page.

I have received some requests for permission to stream videos and live-stream our games, so I have included my guidelines on my store page.

The guidelines are basically designed to allow a large number of people to play the game.

Thank you for your cooperation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751153/c894072cea0f9edb6e190f6e6d96549723db131f.png[/img]

notes.title: Today's Fairy 2
notes.notes:
Hello.
Thank you for your interest in the release of "Fairy Carrots".

I am currently working on debugging the game, and I have confirmed that it works on my Steam Deck and can be played until clear.
Therefore, I have changed the store screen to say that the game can be played on Steam Deck.

I am very happy that we can now bring this game to more people.
I will continue to work hard on the development work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751153/35aa2482df6756e5622a0b9ac2b11b6b547da19f.png[/img]

notes.title: Today's Fairy 1
notes.notes:
Hello.

I plan to release a demo version in December.
I will do my best to make everyone happy.
